displayIdentity.body: Saul proclaims in Damascus and escapes. He took food and was strengthened. Saul stayed several days with the disciples who were at Damascus. but his disciples took him by night and let him down through the wall, lowering him in a basket.
displayIdentity.title: Saul proclaims in Damascus and escapes
